mainEntity.name: When should a contractor consider investing in AEO services?

acceptedAnswer.text: A contractor should consider investing in AEO services when they are looking to grow their business, increase their online visibility, and generate more qualified leads consistently. This is particularly important if they are struggling to appear in local search results, are being outranked by competitors, or want to establish a stronger, more trustworthy brand presence online. Investing in AEO is a strategic move for long-term growth and market dominance, especially in competitive service areas, by building a foundational authority that attracts customers seeking reliable experts.
acceptedAnswer.description: Contractors should invest in AEO when aiming for business growth, increased online visibility, more qualified leads, or to establish a stronger, trustworthy brand.
